newSkills.name: Pressure
newSkills.owner: "increases pressure by +1, every pressure increase deals 2 piercing damage to all units, but gives everyone 1 armor?" Enhanced in deep water, not required.
newSkills.effect: Pressure N (default 1): when it becomes Ready, the Depth rises N (one gauge for the whole field, at most 3 a fight). Each rise: every unit on the field takes 1 water damage that ignores Armor (as Crushing Depths); units with Tide or Pressure take none and gain +1 Armor for the fight (at most +2 from Pressure). Deep water (a Crushing Depths field): each rise deals 2, and the gauge goes to 4.
newSkills.differs: Crushing Depths is a field that hurts every round; Pressure is a unit that raises the stakes a few times and rewards deep-sea units. No existing skill grants Armor to a group or hits the whole field more than once.

newSkills.name: Vaccinate
newSkills.owner: Codex: "Vaccinate / Immunise: grants an ally temporary immunity".
newSkills.effect: Vaccinate N (default 2): when it arrives, it and its adjacent allies are Immune to Sleep, Paralyze, Venom and Decay for N rounds (a timed ENG36 Immune entry: the status never lands and the unit shows the "held off" float). It removes nothing already on them.
newSkills.differs: ENG36 Immune is printed on one card for good. Immunity (ENG24) is self-only and covers sickness, not Sleep. Wakeful is self-only, Sleep only. Cure removes, Vaccinate prevents: the first skill that protects others.

newSkills.name: Vulnerable
newSkills.owner: "+1 damage per counter, one removed per damage instance."
newSkills.effect: Exploit N already does exactly this: its hits put N tokens on the target; each later hit (melee, shot, bolt; not a Venom or Bleed tick) deals +1 and uses one token, before Armor. On no card today.
newSkills.differs: Shock (+50%) is called "Vulnerable" by the SK3 status action, and Unfortify gives the bramble "Vulnerable N". Proposal: the player-facing name of Exploit's tokens becomes Vulnerable; the SK3 action is shown as Shock (decision DES2-3).

newSkills.name: Twin Strike
newSkills.effect: Already so: its second swing re-enters the swing loop, so each swing is its own hit (own Vulnerable token, own On Attack triggers). On Alley Cat (Map 4) and Gatling Hog.
newSkills.differs: Double Time = Twin Strike plus its shots twice; Frenzy = Twin Strike while it has a status; Encore = one more swing on a kill. See section 3.

newSkills.name: Bandage
newSkills.effect: Cure {vs: wounds}, shown as Bandage: every upkeep, takes up to 2 Bleed and every Vulnerable token off your unit with the most Bleed.
newSkills.differs: Cure takes Venom only; Shedding cleans itself; the Cleanse action is a trigger, not a skill. One Cure family with a target: Venom (Cure), wounds (Bandage), spores (the witchdoctor's remedy: Sleep and Paralyze).

newSkills.name: Armoured Shield
newSkills.verdict: a Shield parameter (◦, Map 2 side; ENG37)
newSkills.owner: Owner 11:03: a unit Shield that also gives Armor while the Shield lasts.
newSkills.effect: shield: {v: N, armor: M}: it arrives with N Shield and has +M Armor while any of that Shield is left; the Armor goes with the last Shield point.
newSkills.differs: Shield only soaks; Armor only blocks. Together the Shield lasts longer against many small hits, then the unit is plain again. Home: Conch Crawler (Shell + Shield) on Pebble Beach.

newSkills.name: Retreat into the shell
newSkills.verdict: a Shell parameter (◦, Map 2 side; ENG37)
newSkills.owner: Owner 11:03: after it attacks, +2 Armor until the round ends.
newSkills.effect: shell: {v: 2, after: "attack"}: after its own swing it gains +2 Armor until the round ends. Plain Shell stays "+N Armor when first hit each round".
newSkills.differs: Same family, a different moment: Shell braces when hit, the retreat ducks back after striking (good against Counterattack and the Speed 0 arrows that come after the swings). Home: the hermit crabs and Box Turtle.

newSkills.name: Cold
newSkills.owner: Codex: "reduces an enemy's Attack or Speed; opposite of Heat".
newSkills.effect: Heat's opposite already exists: Frost (+0/+2 while the field is cold). Lowering Attack is Daunt / Corrode / Stagger; lowering Speed is Slow / Stymie; cold attacks are Ice and Freeze.
newSkills.differs: Nothing left for it to do.

newSkills.name: Tangleweed
newSkills.effect: Tangled: half the time its attacks, shots, skills and triggers fail. That is Confused (skills and triggers fail half the time) plus attacks. Strangle is different (Bound: half damage, no moving, 2 a round).
newSkills.differs: It duplicates Confuse more than Strangle. On 2 side-map cards: Weaver Bird to Confuse, Quicksand Queen to Web. The kelp's wrap on Map 9 is Strangle.

newSkills.name: Confusion
newSkills.owner: Codex Map 12: "behaves unpredictably or attacks an unintended target".
newSkills.effect: On-hit Confuse {chance, duration}: Confused, half its triggers, skills and actions fail. On Lyrebird Mimic (Map 12) and Sphinx. "Attacks the wrong target" is Tipsy (Marula Monkey).
newSkills.differs: Use Confuse for the maze; Tipsy stays a drink joke.

newSkills.name: Snare
newSkills.owner: Codex: "prevents movement" (Map 12 side, Kelp Snare on 9).
newSkills.effect: Web (no dodge, no moving), Bola (Pinned) and Strangle (Bound) already hold a unit.

newSkills.name: Undertow
newSkills.effect: Wave {pull}: its hits drag the target one column toward this unit (Anchor and Webbed hold; a crash hurts both as Wave). Today "undertow" is only a raid-boss event (stuns the strongest).
newSkills.differs: Wave pushes away; Undertow pulls in. Same skill, a direction.

newSkills.name: Suffocate
newSkills.effect: Strangle and Constrict already squeeze for damage; Crushing Depths is the underwater danger.
newSkills.differs: Nothing left for it to do.

duplicates.same: All four: "+2/+2 while N units have died". Only who counts differs (any / yours / enemies seen / enemies).
duplicates.plan: Merge into **Carnage** {who: any | yours | foes | seen, N}. One threshold skill.

duplicates.same: Muster / Beset / Throng: "+2/+2 while N units" on your side / theirs / both. Sociable and Formation: +1 per ally nearby (range 2 vs adjacent).
duplicates.plan: Merge Muster / Beset / Throng into **Throng** {who, N}; Sociable into **Formation** {range}.

duplicates.same: Each fires "when a unit dies". Harbinger +1/+1 (any), Berserk +N/+0 (allies), Carrion heals 2, Scavenge Lumber, Retribution strikes, Hive Mind buffs a Swarm ally.
duplicates.plan: Merge Berserk into **Harbinger** {who: ally, gives}. Keep Carrion (heal) and Scavenge (resource). Retribution and Hive Mind: one-offs.

duplicates.same: Momentum +N/+0, Spoils +0/+2; Midas / Felling / Prospector: gain Lumber / Lumber / Metal.
duplicates.plan: Merge Spoils into **Momentum** {hp}; Midas and Prospector into **Felling** {res} (like Delivery's res).

duplicates.same: Twin Strike swings twice (two damage instances). Double Time = Twin Strike + its shots twice. Frenzy = Twin Strike while it has a status. Encore = again on a kill.
duplicates.plan: Keep **Twin Strike**; Double Time becomes Twin Strike {shots}. Keep Frenzy and Encore (conditions differ). Coffee: one-off.

duplicates.same: Darksight "sees in darkness"; Keen Sense also ignores Blind; Echolocation also ignores Smoke, Fog and Shadow. True Sight finds Invisible. Illuminate lights your side (Lantern is its old name).
duplicates.plan: Retire **Darksight** into Keen Sense. Keep Echolocation, True Sight, Illuminate (three different answers).

duplicates.same: Web: no dodge, no moving. Bola: Pinned. Strangle: Bound + 2. Constrict: no action + 2. Lasso: both tied. Tangleweed: half its actions fail, which is Confused.
duplicates.plan: Retire **Tangleweed** (Weaver Bird to Confuse, Quicksand Queen to Web). Merge Constrict into **Strangle** {full}. Keep Web, Bola, Lasso.

duplicates.same: Daunt -N for a round; Weaken -1 for good; Stench -1 a token until washed; Stagger halves; Corrode -N a stack.
duplicates.plan: Merge Weaken and Stench into **Daunt** {lasting | washed}. Keep Stagger (halve) and Corrode (Acid's status).

duplicates.same: Exploit: +1 a hit, one token used per hit (the owner's Vulnerable). Scar: +N for good. Shock: +50% (the SK3 action calls it Vulnerable). Expose strips hiding.
duplicates.plan: Exploit's tokens read **Vulnerable**; the SK3 "Vulnerable" action reads Shock. Merge Scar into Vulnerable {lasting}. Keep Expose.

duplicates.same: Breach: 1 to the bramble a melee hit. Puncture: N. Perforate: Puncture + Pierce + Bleed bundled.
duplicates.plan: Merge Breach into **Puncture** (Breach = Puncture 1). Keep Perforate as a later-map bundle.

duplicates.same: Ice and Ice Arrow have the same text. Fire Arrow and Cinder differ only in Speed (0 vs 1). Archer = Arrow 2 that never swings.
duplicates.plan: Merge Ice Arrow into **Ice**. Archer becomes Arrow {never swings}. Fire Arrow / Cinder: keep (Speed is the point).

duplicates.same: Quick = Speed 2, Blitz = Speed 10, Haste = Speed +2 and +1 to neighbours. Swift = first + dodges (on no card).
duplicates.plan: Blitz becomes **Speed** 10; keep Quick as the Speed 2 name. Retire Swift (on no card).

duplicates.same: Timber and Hoard have the same text (+1/+1 a Lumber). Rock-solid / Iron-will: per Stone / Metal.
duplicates.plan: Merge Timber into **Hoard** {res, N} (ENG36 already phrases Hoard N).

duplicates.same: Stockpile's text is Delivery's word for word. Pearl = Delivery of a Pearl.
duplicates.plan: Retire **Stockpile** into Delivery; Pearl becomes Delivery {res: pearl}.

duplicates.same: Heal: most wounded ally 1. Nursing: weakest wounded ally N. The heal-a-random-ally "Bloom" shares its name with the copy-making Bloom.
duplicates.plan: Merge Nursing into **Heal** {N}. Rename the healing Bloom (key bloom) to avoid two Blooms.

parkingLot: Flying's little brother for gliders (flying squirrel, sugar glider, flying fish): dodges 1 in 4, lands in any free slot. Canopy maps.
A field altitude. Low atmosphere (peaks): Flying weaker, Fire weaker. Below sea level: Pressure rises on its own.
Vents: every round, units not beside a vent take 1 acid, venom or heat. Dry, Immunity and Mountain Climber shrug it off. Tardigrade, yeti crab, Pompeii worm.
Zero gravity: every unit counts as Flying, no Fire, no Tide. Tardigrade as the reward.
Feeble, Mighty, Sturdy, Fragile, Rage: later maps (owner #21). Mighty on Map 14 and 19 is the only early use.
